resolution.note: setup-ci restores RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE/node/<pinned> via actions/cache before setup-node

title: Cache the pinned Node.js toolchain in setup-ci
body: Restore the pinned Node.js toolchain from actions/cache in .github/actions/setup-ci so setup-node finds it in RUNNER_TOOL_CACHE instead of downloading it (about 5 s per shard, about 3 s on the critical path). Keep the mise layout copy the sandbox tests use. Part of the CI speed gap t-wm22s14.
